title: Napster and HUMAIN partner to bring Arabic-Native AI to public and private organizations across the region
summary: The collaboration brings together HUMAIN’s Arabic-first AI capabilities and Napster’s embodied and agentic AI platform to accelerate AI adoption across the region.

contentHtml:
Napster, a frontier AI company powering the next generation of embodied and agentic AI, and HUMAIN, a PIF company delivering full-stack artificial intelligence capabilities globally, announced a strategic partnership. Image courtesy: Napster

The collaboration brings together HUMAIN’s Arabic-first AI capabilities and Napster’s embodied and agentic AI platform to accelerate AI adoption across the region.

Press Release

RIYADH — Napster, a frontier AI company powering the next generation of embodied and agentic AI, and HUMAIN, a PIF company delivering full-stack artificial intelligence capabilities globally, today announced a strategic partnership to bring advanced Arabic-native AI experiences to public and private sector organizations across the MENA region.

The collaboration combines HUMAIN IQ, HUMAIN’s AI services platform, and HUMAIN Voice with Napster’s video presence, Large Persona Model technology and multimodal agent infrastructure. Together, the companies will integrate Arabic-first language and speech capabilities into embodied AI experiences designed for organizations and users across the region.

The partnership also marks an important example of Saudi-developed technology being used to enhance the capabilities of an international technology company, demonstrating HUMAIN’s growing role as a source of technology with international applications.

Through HUMAIN IQ and HUMAIN Voice, Napster will gain programmatic access to selected HUMAIN capabilities through secure APIs, including:

  • ALLAM – HUMAIN’s proprietary large language model, supporting text generation, summarization and function calling;
  • HUMAIN Voice ASR Real Time – Arabic-first, real-time automatic speech recognition that transcribes audio input into text; and
  • HUMAIN Voice TTS Real Time – natural-sounding speech synthesis from text across multiple Arabic dialects.

These capabilities will work alongside Napster’s embodied and agentic AI technologies to create a new class of Arabic-native digital employee. The resulting AI agents are designed to understand and communicate naturally in Arabic, carry persistent memory, and interact with customers and colleagues through voice, video and conversational interfaces.

“Arabic-speaking markets have been underserved by AI platforms built for English-first models. A digital agent that stumbles over the language it’s supposed to speak in is not a workforce solution,” said John Acunto, CEO of Napster. “HUMAIN’s models give our platform the linguistic and cultural fluency to earn trust in this market. That changes what we can offer organizations here.”

With a growing, digitally enabled young workforce and consumer base across the wider region, customers increasingly expect AI to engage with them in Arabic as a baseline and to understand the cultural nuances that shape how they communicate and interact. Napster plans to bring these capabilities directly to its existing public and private sector clients across Saudi Arabia and the Middle East, creating immediate opportunities to deploy Arabic-fluent digital employees at scale.

“The next generation of AI must be native to the markets it serves, but the technology we build in Saudi Arabia should also be capable of extending across new markets,” said Tareq Amin, CEO of HUMAIN. “This partnership is an important example of Saudi-developed AI technology supporting an international technology company. By combining HUMAIN IQ, ALLAM and HUMAIN Voice with Napster’s embodied AI capabilities, we are creating solutions designed for the region while demonstrating the growing international relevance of HUMAIN’s technology.”

The collaboration reflects the complementary strengths of both companies. HUMAIN brings Arabic-first models, speech capabilities and AI services through HUMAIN IQ, while Napster brings its video presence, Large Persona Model technology and multimodal agent infrastructure. Together, the companies aim to make sophisticated, Arabic-native AI experiences easier for public and private sector organizations to deploy.

The partnership also demonstrates the roles of HUMAIN IQ and HUMAIN Voice and HUMAIN Voice as platforms through which Saudi-developed AI capabilities can be integrated into international technologies and applications. Through secure APIs, technology companies can incorporate HUMAIN’s models and services into their own platforms, expanding the reach and practical application of AI technology developed in the Kingdom.

By combining HUMAIN’s sovereign AI capabilities with Napster’s deployment infrastructure, the two companies are positioned to support public and private sector organizations in adopting next-generation AI services without the complexity typically associated with building from scratch.

The HUMAIN partnership is part of Napster’s ongoing commitment to the region and its effort to expand its footprint across the Middle East. Further initiatives and deployments are planned throughout 2026.

About Napster

Founded on the principle of democratizing access, first to music in 1999, now to expertise in the AI era, Napster gives AI a human face. The company builds embodied, multimodal AI agents that people can see, hear, and interact with across web, mobile, phone, and physical environments. By providing a human layer, complete with video presence, voice, and persistent memory, on top of any model, Napster’s agents work alongside and elevate the customer and employee experience, carrying institutional knowledge into every interaction. For more information, visit napster.com.  

About HUMAIN

HUMAIN, a PIF company, is a global artificial intelligence company delivering full-stack AI capabilities across four core areas: next-generation data centers; hyper-performance infrastructure and cloud platforms; advanced AI models, including some of the world's most advanced Arabic large language models developed in the Arab world; and transformative AI solutions that combine deep sector insight with real-world execution.

HUMAIN's end-to-end model serves both public and private sector organizations, unlocking value across industries, driving digital transformation, and strengthening capabilities through human–AI collaboration. With a growing portfolio of sector-specific AI products and a core mission focused on intellectual property development and global talent leadership, HUMAIN is engineered for international competitiveness and technological excellence.
